text: The power gate is a step table: the 35% bracket runs from 40% to just under 60% of recommended power, the 15% bracket from 20% to just under 40%.
detail: Damage kept per bracket: <10% → 1%, 10% → 5%, 20% → 15%, 40% → 35%, 60% → 55%, 80% → 75%, 100% → 100%, 120% → 120% (cap). No interpolation, boss damage to you unchanged. The entry power of each bracket for every chapter's last stage is in stage-chapters.json.

text: Since the 2026-09-23 easing, the 35% bracket clears every main stage to 328-30; the 35% line there is 4.00G.
detail: Screenshot-documented: 328-30 GingerCraven at 4.00G, 312-30 at 2.74G, 288-19 at 1.77G, 266-30 Cool Mint on auto at 1.17G. The easing cut recommended power, enemy ATK and HP by up to 36% (328-30: 15.61G → 10.00G).

text: 15% works on mob stages, not on bosses: GingerCraven, the bikers and the Redberry packs need 35%.
detail: Documented 15% clears are mob stages (301-27 and 301-28 at 2.05G by hand with Brightseeker–Bari–Cherry Cola; 271-11 at 971.8M). 15% GingerCraven attempts fail (41% HP left after an hour at 256-30; about 20% HP removed by a pusher who then cleared first try at 35%). The one 328-30-at-15% claim has no screenshot.

text: The cheapest damage is crossing the next bracket line: pad displayed power rather than fight a step lower.
detail: Both documented 15% mob clears sat just under the 40% line (0.6M and 4.4M short), where padding would have doubled their damage. Pushers keep a pure-power gear preset (뻥투) for bracket lines, keep SSR rune lines that add power until the Rift, and stay in a guild (leaving one dropped a player from 35% to 15%).

text: Run the Bari–Cherry Cola charge deck as the general deck and swap per boss slot; the zone cycle tells you which boss is next.
detail: Panda Dumpling in the third pet slot for launch bosses (Cool Mint, Werehound Princess, Tainted Ent, King Choco Drop); Scorpion and Jungle Warrior for GingerCraven; Jungle Warrior or Tiger Lily and Rye for the Redberry packs; Ion and Icy Birdie for the truck. Chapters cycle through eight zones with fixed boss slots from chapter 169 (stage-zones.json).

text: Accuracy 900–1,000 is enough after the easing; focus matters for the debuffers.
detail: Stage accuracy requirements cap at 1,203.5 from about chapter 248; ND러너 runs about 1,000 past 300 and calls 1,300 wasted. Dark Choco's shred needs focus to land.

text: The Dimensional Rift is a 35% fight at every level, won by parking: 차원의 힘 grows while you sit there and inflates power and stats inside the Rift.
detail: Recommended power runs from 10.00G at level 1 to about 1,800G at level 100 (season 1); the bracket table applies against the Rift-inflated power. Give a level about five tries, then park. Early entry compounds; the leader was at level 19 on 2026-09-28.
